coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 10 enterprise graph visualization platforms in scope: Linkurious, Graphistry, GraphAware Hume, Kineviz GraphXR, Tom Sawyer Perspectives, Cambridge Intelligence (KeyLines/ReGraph), yWorks (yFiles), Gephi, Graphileon, Graphlytic. Coverage includes: (1) Official homepages and product pages (T0 primary capture); (2) Pricing pages and licensing documentation (T0); (3) Official documentation, API docs, changelogs (T1); (4) Review aggregates on G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Gartner Peer Insights (T2); (5) Analyst reports from Gartner, Business Research Company, industry trend reports (T2); (6) Vendor blogs, blog posts, case studies, news releases (T1/T3); (7) GitHub repositories for open-source tools (T1); (8) Comparison guides, alternatives-to articles, listicles (T3); (9) Academic research on graph visualization, HCI/UX usability studies (T1/T2); (10) Related ecosystems: Neo4j Bloom, Memgraph, Cytoscape.js, Sigma.js, D3.js, Ogma (underlying libraries and competitive offerings). Deduplication: eliminated duplicate URLs across multiple searches. Notable gaps: paywalled Gartner/Forrester full analyst reports (referenced but not accessible); detailed TrustRadius reviews require account; specific pricing on some enterprise editions requires direct contact. Tiered authorities: T0 (official product sites, pricing, SEC/Crunchbase funding records); T1 (official docs, changelogs, GitHub, peer-reviewed/conference papers); T2 (Gartner/G2/Capterra/TrustRadius aggregates, analyst reports); T3 (vendor blogs, comparison articles, case studies, Medium posts).
